confidence_notes: July estimates use current prices as proxies. [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Jeonju) has few contributors, so the three-course meal is uncertain. [Cocktail](https://citiesinsider.com/country/south-korea/jeonju/alcohol-and-nightlife) and [wine](https://pickbestplaces.com/south-korea/jeonju/wine-bars) estimates use limited local guidance and are roughly three times beer. Lodging is a holistic estimate, sensitive to weekends and summer demand.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional South Korean cities such as Daejeon provide a basis, adjusted for Jeonju's smaller size and tourism demand around its historic district.
